info.name: Yodlee Core APIs Account Token Institutions API

params.name: dataset$filter
params.description: Expression to filter the providers by dataset(s) or dataset attribute(s). The default value will be the dataset or dataset attributes configured as default for the customer.

params.name: name
params.description: Name in minimum 1 character or routing number.

params.name: skip
params.description: skip (Min 0) - This is not applicable along with 'name' parameter.

params.name: top
params.description: top (Max 500) - This is not applicable along with 'name' parameter.

items.docs: Yodlee classifies providers into credential-based aggregation and Open Banking (OB) providers. The get institutions service helps in identifying credential and related OB sites in a financial institution. The service searches for an institution regardless of the authentication types associated with the providers.
